id: AT-VD-01 (visible defaults: the status settings-values block)
note: 0.1.2 visible defaults (spec Behaviour 1): /status prints a settings-values block. A key whose value is not its default gets one line `<key> <value> (<source>; default <default>)`; the keys at their defaults share one or two `at default:` lines, so every effective value is visible without one line per key. At its default is decided by the value alone, wherever it comes from: the four on/off keys the configure dialog always saves, and plugin option values Claude Code passes, equal to their defaults stay on the at-default lines. Source labels: settings file -> `your settings.json`, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* -> `plugin option`, default. A clamped number says `clamped from N`. Never echoed: ticket_pattern shows built-in or custom, secret_extra_rules and the other list keys their entry count. The existing `settings:` and `thresholds:` lines stay as they were.
